title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Business Finance Definition
text:
Business Finance Definition

Key terms: business finance, assets, operations

Money required for carrying out business activities, including establishing, running, modernizing, expanding, or diversifying a business, as well as buying assets and managing day-to-day operations.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to remember concepts related to Business Finance Definition in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Importance of Financial Management
text:
Importance of Financial Management

Key terms: financial management, financial health, funds

Financial management is crucial for a business's survival and growth, as it affects the financial health reflected in financial statements and ensures the availability of funds when required.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Importance of Financial Management in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Objectives of Financial Management
text:
Objectives of Financial Management

Key terms: maximize shareholders' wealth, efficient decisions, market price of equity shares

The primary aim of financial management is to maximize shareholders' wealth by making efficient decisions that add value, ultimately increasing the market price of equity shares.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Objectives of Financial Management in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Investment Decision
text:
Investment Decision

Key terms: investment decision, capital budgeting, working capital management

Investment decision involves choosing how and where to invest a firm's resources to earn the highest possible return for investors, including long-term capital budgeting decisions and short-term working capital management.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to analyze concepts related to Investment Decision in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Financing Decision
text:
Financing Decision

Key terms: financing decision, long-term sources, costs, risks

Financing decision involves determining the quantum of finance to be raised from various long-term sources, such as shareholders' funds and borrowed funds, considering their basic characteristics, costs, and associated risks.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to evaluate concepts related to Financing Decision in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Financing Sources and Costs
text:
Financing Sources and Costs

Key terms: debt, equity, financial risk, cost of capital

Different financing sources like debt, equity, and preference shares have varying costs and risks. Debt is generally cheaper due to tax deductibility of interest but has financial risk.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Financing Sources and Costs in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Floatation Costs
text:
Floatation Costs

Key terms: floatation costs, raising funds, expenses

Floatation costs are the expenses incurred while raising funds from different sources. Higher floatation costs make a source less attractive.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Floatation Costs in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Cash Flow and Financing Decisions
text:
Cash Flow and Financing Decisions

Key terms: cash flow, fixed operating costs, financing decisions

A company's cash flow position and fixed operating costs influence its financing decisions. Strong cash flow may make debt financing more viable, while high fixed costs may require lower debt financing.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Cash Flow and Financing Decisions in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Control Considerations in Financing
text:
Control Considerations in Financing

Key terms: control, dilution, takeover bid, debt, equity

Issuing more equity may lead to dilution of management's control over the business, while debt financing has no such implication. Companies afraid of a takeover bid may prefer debt to equity.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to analyze concepts related to Control Considerations in Financing in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Dividend Decision Factors
text:
Dividend Decision Factors

Key terms: dividend, retained earnings, earnings, cash flow, shareholder preferences

The decision to distribute dividends or retain earnings depends on factors like earnings, stability, growth opportunities, cash flow, and shareholder preferences.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Dividend Decision Factors in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Financial Planning Objectives
text:
Financial Planning Objectives

Key terms: financial planning, funds, forecasting, business functions

Financial planning aims to ensure funds are available when needed and to avoid raising resources unnecessarily. It helps in forecasting, avoiding business shocks, and coordinating business functions.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Financial Planning Objectives in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Capital Structure Decision
text:
Capital Structure Decision

Key terms: capital structure, financing pattern, debt, equity, growth

The decision regarding the financing pattern or proportion of debt and equity in a company's capital structure affects its growth and viability.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to evaluate concepts related to Capital Structure Decision in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Financial Analysis Importance
text:
Financial Analysis Importance

Key terms: Financial Analysis, Borrowing Decisions, Credit Pitfalls

Financial analysis is crucial for successful businesses. It helps entrepreneurs make sound borrowing decisions and understand their business's financial health. Many entrepreneurs overlook this, leading to credit pitfalls.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Financial Analysis Importance in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Capital Structure Definition
text:
Capital Structure Definition

Key terms: Capital Structure, Equity, Debt, Debt-Equity Ratio

Capital structure refers to the mix of owners' funds (equity) and borrowed funds (debt) used by a business. It can be calculated as the debt-equity ratio or the proportion of debt out of the total capital.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to remember concepts related to Capital Structure Definition in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Cost of Debt vs Equity
text:
Cost of Debt vs Equity

Key terms: Cost of Debt, Cost of Equity, Financial Risk

Debt is cheaper than equity because lenders have lower risk. Interest paid on debt is also tax-deductible, making debt more attractive. However, increased use of debt raises financial risk.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Cost of Debt vs Equity in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Financial Leverage Impact
text:
Financial Leverage Impact

Key terms: Financial Leverage, Profitability, Return on Investment, Cost of Debt

Financial leverage increases the cost of funds but also increases financial risk. It can increase profitability (favorable leverage) or decrease it (unfavorable leverage), depending on the company's return on investment (RoI) and cost of debt.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to analyze concepts related to Financial Leverage Impact in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Trading on Equity
text:
Trading on Equity

Key terms: Trading on Equity, Return on Investment, Cost of Debt, Financial Risk

Trading on equity involves increasing profit by using cheaper debt. It's favorable when the RoI is higher than the cost of debt but unfavorable when the RoI is lower. It also increases financial risk.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Trading on Equity in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Optimal Capital Structure
text:
Optimal Capital Structure

Key terms: Optimal Capital Structure, Shareholders' Wealth, Profitability, Financial Risk

The optimal capital structure is when the proportion of debt and equity results in an increase in the value of the equity share, maximizing shareholders' wealth. It's a balance between profitability and financial risk.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to evaluate concepts related to Optimal Capital Structure in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Factors Affecting Capital Structure
text:
Factors Affecting Capital Structure

Key terms: Capital Structure, Cash Flow, Interest Coverage Ratio, Debt Service Coverage Ratio, Return on Investment

Factors affecting capital structure include cash flow position, interest coverage ratio, debt service coverage ratio, return on investment, cost of debt, tax rate, cost of equity, floatation costs, risk consideration, flexibility, control, regulatory framework, stock market conditions, and capital structure of other companies.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to create concepts related to Factors Affecting Capital Structure in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Current Assets
text:
Current Assets

Key terms: current assets, liquidity, inventory

Assets that can be converted into cash within one year, like inventories, debtors, and bills receivable. They provide liquidity but have lower returns.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to remember concepts related to Current Assets in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Fixed Capital Management
text:
Fixed Capital Management

Key terms: fixed capital, investment decisions, long-term assets

Decisions involving long-term assets that affect the growth, profitability, and risk of the business. These assets are financed through long-term sources like equity or loans.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Fixed Capital Management in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Capital Budgeting
text:
Capital Budgeting

Key terms: capital budgeting, investment decisions, long-term projects

Process of evaluating long-term projects or assets based on their expected returns. It helps in making informed investment decisions.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Capital Budgeting in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Working Capital
text:
Working Capital

Key terms: working capital, current assets, current liabilities

Current assets minus current liabilities. It's the capital used in day-to-day operations and is crucial for smooth business functioning.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to remember concepts related to Working Capital in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Factors Affecting Fixed Capital Requirements
text:
Factors Affecting Fixed Capital Requirements

Key terms: fixed capital requirements, nature of business, scale of operations

Factors like nature of business, scale of operations, choice of technique, and growth prospects influence the requirement of fixed capital.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to analyze concepts related to Factors Affecting Fixed Capital Requirements in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Factors Affecting Working Capital Requirements
text:
Factors Affecting Working Capital Requirements

Key terms: working capital requirements, nature of business, scale of operations

Factors like nature of business, scale of operations, business cycle, and operating efficiency impact the working capital requirements.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to analyze concepts related to Factors Affecting Working Capital Requirements in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Financial Management Objectives
text:
Financial Management Objectives

Key terms: financial management, wealth maximization, financial decisions

The primary aim of financial management is to maximize shareholders' wealth through optimal procurement and usage of finance.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Financial Management Objectives in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Capital Structure
text:
Capital Structure

Key terms: capital structure, owners' funds, borrowed funds

The mix between owners' and borrowed funds used to finance a business. Deciding the capital structure involves determining the relative proportion of various types of funds.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Capital Structure in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Capital Structure
text:
Capital Structure

Key terms: Owners Funds, Borrowed Funds, Capital Structure

The mix between owners and borrowed funds, determined by factors like cash flow, interest rates, and risk considerations.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Capital Structure in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Fixed Capital
text:
Fixed Capital

Key terms: Fixed Capital, Investment Decisions, Capital Budgeting

Investment in long-term assets, like buildings and machinery, affecting the business's growth, profitability, and risk.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Fixed Capital in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Working Capital
text:
Working Capital

Key terms: Working Capital, Current Assets, Business Cycle

Current assets needed for day-to-day operations, influenced by factors like business nature, scale, and cycle.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to remember concepts related to Working Capital in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Capital Structure Decisions
text:
Capital Structure Decisions

Key terms: Risk-Return Relationship, Capital Structure Decisions

Optimization of risk-return relationship by deciding the proportion of owners and borrowed funds.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to analyze concepts related to Capital Structure Decisions in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Working Capital Requirements
text:
Working Capital Requirements

Key terms: Working Capital Requirements, Business Nature, Scale of Operations

Determinants like business nature, scale, and cycle affect the need for current assets to facilitate smooth operations.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Working Capital Requirements in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Financial Planning
text:
Financial Planning

Key terms: Financial Planning, Funds Required, Timing of Funds

Estimating funds required and their timing to ensure availability for future operations and growth.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Financial Planning in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Financial Risk
text:
Financial Risk

Key terms: Financial Risk, Capital Structure Decisions, Financial Fortunes

Risk arising from financial decisions, like capital structure, affecting the business's financial fortunes.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to evaluate concepts related to Financial Risk in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Dividend Decision Factors
text:
Dividend Decision Factors

Key terms: Dividend Decision, Earnings, Cash Flow, Investment Opportunities

Factors like earnings, cash flow, and investment opportunities influence the decision to pay dividends.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to create concepts related to Dividend Decision Factors in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Marketing Definition
text:
Marketing Definition

Key terms: social process, exchange, customer needs

Marketing is a social process where people exchange goods and services for money or something of value. It involves identifying customer needs, creating offerings, and facilitating exchanges.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Marketing Definition in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Market Definition
text:
Market Definition

Key terms: actual buyers, potential buyers, set of buyers

In marketing, a market refers to a set of actual and potential buyers of a product or service. It's broader than the traditional sense of a place where buyers and sellers gather.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Market Definition in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Needs and Wants
text:
Needs and Wants

Key terms: needs, wants, customer satisfaction

Needs are basic human requirements, while wants are culturally defined objects that satisfy needs. Marketers identify customer needs and wants to develop products and services.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Needs and Wants in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Market Offering
text:
Market Offering

Key terms: market offering, customer needs, customer preferences

A market offering is a complete offer for a product or service, including features, price, availability, and location. It's developed based on customer needs and preferences.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Market Offering in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Customer Value
text:
Customer Value

Key terms: customer value, perceived benefit, product cost

Customer value is the perceived benefit of a product or service in relation to its cost. Marketers aim to add value to their products to make them more appealing to customers.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Customer Value in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Exchange Mechanism
text:
Exchange Mechanism

Key terms: exchange mechanism, necessary conditions, marketing process

The exchange mechanism is how marketing works. It involves two parties exchanging products or services for something of value, with certain necessary conditions being met.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Exchange Mechanism in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Marketing Management
text:
Marketing Management

Key terms: marketing management, exchange outcomes, target markets

Marketing management involves planning, organizing, directing, and controlling activities that facilitate exchanges between producers and consumers. It focuses on achieving desired exchange outcomes with target markets.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Marketing Management in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | What Can Be Marketed?
text:
What Can Be Marketed?

Key terms: physical products, services, ideas, marketing choices

A wide range of things can be marketed, including physical products, services, ideas, persons, places, events, and information. Marketers choose what to market based on customer needs and preferences.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to What Can Be Marketed? in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Marketing Objectives
text:
Marketing Objectives

Key terms: demand, customer satisfaction, superior values

Marketing objectives involve creating demand for products, satisfying customers, and attracting more customers to grow the firm. This is achieved by creating, developing, and communicating superior values for customers.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to remember concepts related to Marketing Objectives in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Marketing Management Functions
text:
Marketing Management Functions

Key terms: analysis, planning, implementation, control

Marketing management involves analyzing and planning marketing activities, implementing marketing plans, and setting control mechanisms to achieve organizational objectives at minimum cost.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Marketing Management Functions in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Demand Management
text:
Demand Management

Key terms: overfull demand, seasonal products, demand management

Marketing managers may need to manage demand by reducing expenditure on promotion or increasing prices in case of overfull demand, or changing the time pattern of demand for seasonal products.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Demand Management in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Marketing Philosophies
text:
Marketing Philosophies

Key terms: marketing philosophies, production concept, product concept, selling concept, marketing concept, societal marketing concept

Marketing philosophies guide an organization's marketing efforts and determine the emphasis on different factors to achieve organizational objectives. These philosophies have evolved over time and include production, product, selling, marketing, and societal concepts.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to analyze concepts related to Marketing Philosophies in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Marketing Versus Selling
text:
Marketing Versus Selling

Key terms: marketing, selling, customer needs

Marketing is a broader term that encompasses planning, pricing, promoting, and distributing products to satisfy customer needs, while selling is a part of marketing that focuses on transferring the title of the product from the seller to the buyer.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to evaluate concepts related to Marketing Versus Selling in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Marketing Concept Pillars
text:
Marketing Concept Pillars

Key terms: marketing concept, target market, customer needs, profit

The marketing concept is based on five pillars: identifying the target market, understanding customer needs, developing products or services to satisfy those needs, satisfying needs better than competitors, and doing so at a profit.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to create concepts related to Marketing Concept Pillars in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Societal Marketing Concept
text:
Societal Marketing Concept

Key terms: societal marketing concept, long-term well-being, social, ethical, and ecological aspects

The societal marketing concept extends the marketing concept by considering the long-term well-being of consumers and society, paying attention to social, ethical, and ecological aspects of marketing.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to create concepts related to Societal Marketing Concept in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Functions of Marketing
text:
Functions of Marketing

Key terms: marketing functions, customer satisfaction, market information, marketing planning

Marketing is concerned with exchanging goods and services to maximize customer satisfaction. Its functions include gathering and analyzing market information, marketing planning, product designing and development, standardisation and grading, packaging and labeling, pricing, promotion, and distribution.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to remember concepts related to Functions of Marketing in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Grading of Products
text:
Grading of Products

Key terms: Grading, Quality, Price

Sorting products based on quality, size, etc. to ensure customers get what they pay for and help in realizing higher prices for high quality output.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Grading of Products in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Packaging and Labelling
text:
Packaging and Labelling

Key terms: Packaging, Labelling, Promotion

Designing and developing product packages and labels to protect products, promote them, and provide information to customers.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Packaging and Labelling in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Customer Support Services
text:
Customer Support Services

Key terms: After-sales services, Customer satisfaction, Brand loyalty

Providing after-sales services, handling complaints, and offering credit services to maximize customer satisfaction and build brand loyalty.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Customer Support Services in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Pricing of Product
text:
Pricing of Product

Key terms: Price, Demand, Production costs

Determining the amount of money customers pay for a product, considering factors like demand, competition, and production costs.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Pricing of Product in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Promotion of Products
text:
Promotion of Products

Key terms: Promotion, Advertising, Sales promotion

Informing customers about products, their features, and persuading them to purchase through advertising, personal selling, publicity, and sales promotion.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Promotion of Products in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Physical Distribution
text:
Physical Distribution

Key terms: Physical distribution, Inventory management, Transportation

Managing the movement of products from producers to consumers, including inventory management, storage, warehousing, and transportation.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Physical Distribution in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Branding
text:
Branding

Key terms: Branding, Brand name, Customer loyalty

Creating a brand name and strategy to differentiate products, build customer loyalty, and promote sales.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Branding in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Product Classification
text:
Product Classification

Key terms: Product classification, Convenience products, Shopping products

Categorizing products based on consumer needs, durability, and shopping efforts involved, such as convenience, shopping, and specialty products.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to analyze concepts related to Product Classification in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Durable Products
text:
Durable Products

Key terms: durable, tangible, consumer goods, per unit margin, personal selling, after-sales services

Durable products are tangible consumer goods that last for many years, such as refrigerators, radios, bicycles, and sewing machines. They command a higher per unit margin, require personal selling efforts, guarantees, and after-sales services.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Durable Products in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Services
text:
Services

Key terms: intangible, activities, benefits, sale, professional services

Services are intangible activities or benefits offered for sale, such as dry cleaning, watch repairs, hair cutting, postal services, and professional services like those provided by doctors, architects, and lawyers.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Services in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Industrial Products
text:
Industrial Products

Key terms: industrial, inputs, producing, raw materials, non-personal, business use

Industrial products are used as inputs in producing other products, such as raw materials, engines, lubricants, machines, and tools. They are meant for non-personal and business use.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Industrial Products in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Branding
text:
Branding

Key terms: branding, name, sign, symbol, identify, distinguish, brand name, brand mark

Branding is the process of giving a name, sign, or symbol to a product to identify and distinguish it from competitors. A brand has two components: brand name (verbal) and brand mark (non-verbal).

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Branding in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Packaging
text:
Packaging

Key terms: packaging, container, wrapper, protect, facilitate, promote

Packaging refers to the act of designing and producing the container or wrapper of a product. It plays a crucial role in the marketing success of consumer non-durable products by protecting the product, facilitating its use, and promoting it.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Packaging in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Levels of Packaging
text:
Levels of Packaging

Key terms: levels, packaging, primary, secondary, transportation

There are three levels of packaging: primary (immediate container), secondary (additional protection), and transportation (storage, identification, or transportation).

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Levels of Packaging in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Importance of Packaging
text:
Importance of Packaging

Key terms: importance, packaging, health standards, self-service, innovative, differentiation, protection

Packaging is important due to rising health standards, self-service outlets, innovative opportunities, product differentiation, and protection during storage and transportation.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Importance of Packaging in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Functions of Packaging
text:
Functions of Packaging

Key terms: functions, packaging, identification, protection, facilitate, promotion

Packaging functions include product identification, protection, facilitating use, and promotion.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Functions of Packaging in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Label Functions in Marketing
text:
Label Functions in Marketing

Key terms: labels, sales promotion, information required by law

Labels on products serve multiple purposes: promoting sales, providing required information, and communicating with potential buyers.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Label Functions in Marketing in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Definition of Price
text:
Definition of Price

Key terms: price, buyer, seller

Price is the amount of money paid by a buyer to a seller in exchange for a product or service.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to remember concepts related to Definition of Price in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Factors Affecting Price Determination
text:
Factors Affecting Price Determination

Key terms: cost, demand, competition, pricing objectives

Price of a product is influenced by its cost, utility and demand, competition, government regulations, pricing objectives, and marketing methods.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Factors Affecting Price Determination in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Physical Distribution
text:
Physical Distribution

Key terms: physical distribution, transportation, warehousing, inventory control

Physical distribution involves moving goods from producers to customers, ensuring they are available at the right place, time, and quantity.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Physical Distribution in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Components of Physical Distribution
text:
Components of Physical Distribution

Key terms: order processing, transportation, warehousing, inventory control

Physical distribution includes order processing, transportation, warehousing, and inventory control.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Components of Physical Distribution in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Word of Mouth Marketing in India
text:
Word of Mouth Marketing in India

Key terms: word of mouth, marketing, India

In India, word of mouth marketing is highly influential, with people often relying on references from friends and relatives for purchasing decisions.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.topic: Word of Mouth Marketing in India
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Word of Mouth Marketing in India in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Inventory Management
text:
Inventory Management

Key terms: inventory, service level, carrying cost

Balancing inventory levels to meet customer demand while minimizing carrying costs.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Inventory Management in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Promotion
text:
Promotion

Key terms: communication, potential customers, persuade

Using communication to inform potential customers about a product and persuade them to buy it.

metadata.subject: Business Studies
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Promotion in Grade 12 Business Studies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Business Studies | Promotion Mix
text:
Promotion Mix

Key terms: promotional tools, communication objectives, advertising, personal selling, sales promotion, publicity

Combination of promotional tools used to achieve communication objectives.
